vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause, this statement accesses the alts array using data->sco_num as an index without validating that the index stays within bounds of the three-entry table. The Second Evidence Set confirms this location had bounds-checking added (using min_t with ARRAY_SIZE(alts)), indicating the original code lacked this protection and allowed out-of-bounds memory read when data->sco_num exceeded the valid range.
